zh.headline: Meta 开源 Muse 设备代码
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是「agent 基础设施」全面成型：从 NVIDIA OpenShell 的安全运行时、Google AX 的编排器，到 context-mode 的上下文压缩，再到 Apple 因 agent 风险收紧 macOS 权限——围绕 agent 的运行时、权限、编排、记忆四条底座正在同时被补齐。与此同时，Meta Muse 开源硬件代码与 OpenAI Dots 企业平台正面交锋，个人 agent 入口之争正式开打。模型层面，Gemini 4 Argon 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 的价格战叠加 TACO、LoRA 修复等微调/推理效率研究，说明竞争焦点已从「更强」转向「更省、更可控」。值得警惕的是 OpenAI 安全团队泄密解雇与蒸馏攻击披露，前沿实验室的安全治理与知识产权攻防正在成为新的不确定性来源。

items.title: Meta 开源 Muse 设备代码
items.desc: Meta 将 Muse AI agent 的硬件接入代码开源，允许开发者自行打造搭载 Muse 的智能设备（如彩色墨水屏提醒器、HDMI 投屏棒等）。
items.value: 消费级 AI 硬件门槛骤降，个人开发者可直接做原型

items.title: OpenAI 发布 Dots agent 平台
items.desc: OpenAI 推出面向企业的 agent 平台 Dots，定位工作场景，可执行订餐等日常任务，与 Meta Muse 争夺个人 AI agent 入口。
items.value: 企业级 agent 平台竞争白热化，集成与工作流设计成关键

items.title: Apple 收紧 macOS 全盘访问权限
items.desc: Apple 宣布对 macOS「Full Disk Access」增加新管控，理由是 AI agent 能力提升使广泛文件访问风险显著上升。
items.value: 桌面 agent 需重新设计权限模型，沙箱化成必然

items.title: NVIDIA 发布 64GB DGX Spark
items.desc: NVIDIA 联合 Acer/ASUS/Dell 等推出 64GB 版 DGX Spark，GB10 驱动、1 PetaFLOP，可双机集群至 128GB 内存。
items.value: 本地跑大模型与 agent 的桌面级方案，双机可扩展

items.title: Google 开源 agent 编排器 AX
items.desc: Google 开源面向自主 AI 代理的 Kubernetes 风格编排器 AX。
items.value: 多 agent 调度有了标准化编排层，利于规模化部署

items.title: OpenAI 安全团队人事震荡
items.desc: 据 WSJ，OpenAI 因三名研究员涉嫌向外部 AI 安全组织泄露机密信息而将其解雇，另有一人离职。
items.value: 前沿实验室安全治理与信息管控矛盾公开化

items.title: Suno 新增语音生成功能
items.desc: AI 音乐生成器 Suno 推出 Speech 功能，可根据脚本生成旁白并同步生成配乐，已公测。
items.value: 音频内容生产一体化，播客/有声书场景直接受益

items.title: Google Gemini Live 推出 Guided Vision
items.desc: Gemini Live 在兼容 Android 设备上线 Guided Vision，可对摄像头实时画面提供音频描述，如读小字、识别物体。
items.value: 实时视觉辅助落地移动端，无障碍与现场作业受益

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 系列模型指南
items.desc: OpenAI 发布面向创业者的 GPT-6 家族模型选择指南，涵盖推理强度调节、prompt 与技能优化、工具编排。
items.value: 生产环境选型与调优的官方参考，降低试错成本

items.title: OpenAI 披露模型蒸馏攻击
items.desc: OpenAI 称已瓦解一场协同的模型蒸馏行动，该行动试图提取受保护的模型推理过程。
items.value: 模型知识产权攻防升级，API 供应商需加强防护

items.title: AWS 警告社区勿阻挠数据中心
items.desc: AWS CEO Matt Garman 发 3000 字长文，呼吁公众支持 AI 数据中心项目，否则将损害美国经济与国家安全。
items.value: AI 基建与社区/能源矛盾加剧，政策博弈升温

items.title: Ego2Act：第一人称视频生成中的目标导向操作评估
items.desc: 提出评估视频生成模型作为具身世界模拟器在多步物理推理与目标导向操作上的能力。
items.value: 为视频世界模型的具身规划能力提供新评测基准

items.title: Honeycomb：视频世界模型的恒定大小场景记忆
items.desc: 提出 HexMemory 低秩表示，用固定大小记忆存储场景特征，解决长时视频生成记忆膨胀问题。
items.value: 长时视频生成的内存瓶颈有了常数级解法

items.title: LOCI：流式世界模型的空间线性记忆
items.desc: 混合空间记忆架构，兼顾键值缓存细节与循环记忆的紧凑性，支持视角回访重现。
items.value: 流式世界模型在细节与内存间取得平衡

items.title: Transformer 过早停止思考，一个微小 LoRA 即可修复
items.desc: 研究发现预训练 Transformer 深度利用率低，在早期层加 rank-8 LoRA 可将 Qwen3-8B 长链准确率从 15.5% 提至 99%。
items.value: 极低成本大幅提升长上下文推理，权重全冻结

items.title: CorrGRPO：多奖励学习的相关性归一化 GRPO
items.desc: 指出 GRPO 多奖励求和后按组内标准差归一化会因奖励协方差导致优势被压缩，提出相关性归一化修正。
items.value: 多奖励 RL 训练稳定性提升，直接可用于推理模型

items.title: KaliBench：Kali Linux 网络安全工具使用基准
items.desc: 针对 LLM 生成真实网络安全工具可执行命令的能力，提供免运行时可验证奖励的细粒度基准。
items.value: 安全 agent 的命令级评估缺口被填补

items.title: VISTA：交互世界中的视觉推理框架
items.desc: 为通用多模态模型提供长时程视觉能力与无损视觉记忆，支持主动检索历史观察。
items.value: 多模态模型在交互环境中的长时程推理能力增强

items.title: TACO：LLM 微调的三元绝对最大列稀疏优化器
items.desc: 针对全参微调优化器状态内存开销，提出三元稀疏优化器，缓解 AdamW 与 Muon 的几何差异问题。
items.value: 大幅降低微调显存，使更大模型可在现有 GPU 上微调

items.title: SemanTok：可预测语义 token 的高效自回归视频生成
items.desc: 面向自回归视频世界模型，提出粗到细的灵活长度语义 tokenizer，兼顾保真度与语义。
items.value: 自回归视频生成的质量与效率同步提升

items.title: GPT-6 Astra 机器人 agent：成功率提升 14%、token 减少 65%
items.desc: 提出 PyRUA-Lean 交互式代码执行框架，通过选择性观察与反馈驱动原语组合降低 token 开销。
items.value: 机器人 agent 的 token 成本大幅下降，实用性提升

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: 为 AI agent 提供读取与搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站、小红书的能力，单一 CLI、零 API 费用。
items.value: 一站式社媒数据接入，agent 信息获取成本归零

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.desc: 面向自主 AI agent 的安全、私密运行时。
items.value: agent 执行环境的安全隔离有了官方级方案

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.desc: 让 AI agent 像最懒的资深工程师一样思考，主张「最好的代码是你从未写过的代码」。
items.value: 减少 agent 过度生成，直击代码臃肿痛点

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.desc: 可用的 agentic 技能框架与软件开发方法论。
items.value: 为 agent 技能组织提供成体系的方法论

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.desc: AI 编码 agent 的上下文窗口优化，沙箱化工具输出（减少 98%）、持久化会话记忆、跨 17 平台路由。
items.value: 上下文压缩近 98%，编码 agent 长会话更稳

items.title: mvschwarz/openrig
items.desc: 用 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi 构建自有 agent 网络，支持角色、共享上下文与任务归属的持久团队。
items.value: 多 agent 团队协作编排的开源实现

items.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
items.desc: 写 HTML 即可渲染视频，专为 agent 打造。
items.value: agent 生成视频的流水线大幅简化

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: 预索引代码知识图谱，随代码变更自动同步，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor 等，本地运行。
items.value: 减少 token 与工具调用，提升编码 agent 效率

items.title: 「harness 即公司」：SaaS 将变成模型的套壳外壳
items.desc: 一篇 HN 热帖（86 分、65 评论）主张每家 SaaS 企业最终都会变成围绕某个模型的 harness，引发对软件商业模式可持续性的广泛争论。
items.value: 产品护城河从功能转向 harness 与工作流设计

items.title: 「有人用编码 agent 产出好代码吗？」
items.desc: HN 上关于编码 agent 实际产出的讨论（含「四大骑士」agentic coding 文章 105 分、80 评论）持续发酵，开发者对 agent 生成代码质量仍存疑虑。
items.value: agent 编码落地仍需方法论与工具链配合

en.headline: Meta open sources Muse device code
en.observation: Today's clearest signal is that "agent infrastructure" is fully taking shape: from NVIDIA OpenShell's secure runtime and Google AX's orchestrator to context-mode's context compression, plus Apple tightening macOS permissions over agent risk—the four foundations of runtime, permissions, orchestration, and memory are being filled in simultaneously. Meanwhile, Meta Muse's open-source hardware code and OpenAI's Dots enterprise platform are clashing head-on, officially kicking off the race for the personal agent entry point. At the model layer, the price war between Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6.1 Sol, combined with efficiency research like TACO and the LoRA fix, shows the competitive focus shifting from "stronger" to "cheaper and more controllable." Notably, OpenAI's safety-team leak firings and the distillation attack disclosure make frontier-lab safety governance and IP attack/defense a new source of uncertainty.

items.title: Meta open sources Muse device code
items.desc: Meta open sourced the hardware integration code for its Muse AI agent, letting developers build their own Muse-powered gadgets (color E Ink reminders, HDMI sticks, etc.).
items.value: Consumer AI hardware barrier drops; devs can prototype directly

items.title: OpenAI launches Dots agent platform
items.desc: OpenAI introduced Dots, an enterprise-facing agent platform positioned for work, capable of tasks like ordering food, competing with Meta Muse for the personal AI agent entry point.
items.value: Enterprise agent platform race heats up; integration is key

items.title: Apple tightens macOS Full Disk Access
items.desc: Apple announced new controls around macOS "Full Disk Access," citing substantially increased risk from increasingly capable AI agents.
items.value: Desktop agents must redesign permission models; sandboxing inevitable

items.title: NVIDIA releases 64GB DGX Spark
items.desc: NVIDIA, with Acer/ASUS/Dell and others, launched a 64GB DGX Spark, GB10-powered at 1 PetaFLOP, clusterable to 128GB across two units.
items.value: Desktop-grade local LLM/agent solution, expandable via clustering

items.title: Google open sources agent orchestrator AX
items.desc: Google open sourced AX, a Kubernetes-style orchestrator for autonomous AI agents.
items.value: Standardized orchestration layer for scaling multi-agent deployments

items.title: OpenAI safety team shakeup
items.desc: Per WSJ, OpenAI parted ways with three researchers who allegedly leaked confidential info to an outside AI safety org, with a fourth departure.
items.value: Frontier lab safety governance vs. info control conflict goes public

items.title: Suno adds speech generation
items.desc: AI music generator Suno launched a Speech feature that generates narration with matched background music, now in public beta.
items.value: Unified audio content production benefits podcasts/audiobooks

items.title: Google Gemini Live launches Guided Vision
items.desc: Guided Vision rolled out in Gemini Live on compatible Android devices, providing real-time audio descriptions of camera views, like reading small text or identifying objects.
items.value: Real-time visual assistance lands on mobile; accessibility benefits

items.title: OpenAI publishes GPT-6 family model guide
items.desc: OpenAI released a guide for startups on choosing GPT-6 models, tuning reasoning effort, improving prompts/skills, and orchestrating tools.
items.value: Official reference for production selection and tuning

items.title: OpenAI discloses model distillation attack
items.desc: OpenAI said it disrupted a coordinated model-distillation campaign that sought to extract protected model reasoning.
items.value: Model IP attack/defense escalates; API providers must harden

items.title: AWS warns communities not to block data centers
items.desc: AWS CEO Matt Garman penned a 3,000-word post urging public support for AI data center projects, warning of harm to the US economy and national security.
items.value: AI infrastructure vs. community/energy friction intensifies

items.title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
items.desc: Proposes a benchmark evaluating video generation models as embodied world simulators on multi-step physical reasoning and goal-directed manipulation.
items.value: New benchmark for embodied planning in video world models

items.title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory for Video World Models
items.desc: Introduces HexMemory, a low-rank representation storing scene features in fixed-size memory, solving memory growth in long-horizon video generation.
items.value: Constant-size solution to long-video generation memory bottleneck

items.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
items.desc: A hybrid spatial-memory architecture balancing key-value cache detail with recurrent memory compactness, enabling viewpoint revisits.
items.value: Streaming world models balance detail and memory

items.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
items.desc: Finds pretrained transformers underuse depth; a rank-8 LoRA at an early layer lifts Qwen3-8B long-chain accuracy from 15.5% to 99%.
items.value: Huge long-context reasoning gain at near-zero cost

items.title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
items.desc: Shows GRPO's summed multi-reward normalization compresses advantages due to reward covariance, proposing correlation normalization.
items.value: Improves multi-reward RL stability; directly usable for reasoning models

items.title: KaliBench: Cybersecurity Tool Use Benchmark on Kali Linux
items.desc: A fine-grained benchmark with runtime-free verifiable rewards for LLMs generating executable commands for real cybersecurity tools.
items.value: Fills the command-level evaluation gap for security agents

items.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
items.desc: Gives general-purpose multimodal models long-horizon vision and lossless visual memory with active retrieval of past observations.
items.value: Boosts long-horizon reasoning in interactive environments

items.title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
items.desc: Targets optimizer state memory in full fine-tuning with a ternary sparse optimizer, mitigating AdamW/Muon geometry mismatch.
items.value: Slashes fine-tuning VRAM, enabling larger models on existing GPUs

items.title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
items.desc: Proposes a coarse-to-fine flexible-length semantic tokenizer for autoregressive video world models, balancing fidelity and semantics.
items.value: Simultaneous gains in autoregressive video quality and efficiency

items.title: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents: 14% Higher Success, 65% Fewer Tokens
items.desc: Introduces PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework using selective observation and feedback-driven primitive composition to cut token overhead.
items.value: Robot agent token costs drop sharply, boosting practicality

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.desc: Gives AI agents the ability to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu—one CLI, zero API fees.
items.value: One-stop social data access; agent info-gathering cost near zero

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.desc: A safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
items.value: Official-grade secure isolation for agent execution

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.desc: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room—the best code is the code you never wrote.
items.value: Cuts agent over-generation; targets code bloat

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.desc: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology that works.
items.value: Provides a systematic methodology for organizing agent skills

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.desc: Context window optimization for AI coding agents—sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, routes across 17 platforms.
items.value: ~98% context compression; stabler long coding-agent sessions

items.title: mvschwarz/openrig
items.desc: Build your own agent network from Claude Code, Codex, and Pi—persistent teams with roles, shared context, and owned work.
items.value: Open-source implementation of multi-agent team orchestration

items.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
items.desc: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
items.value: Greatly simplifies agent-driven video generation pipelines

items.title: colbymchenry/codegraph
items.desc: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto-syncing on code changes, supporting Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, etc., running 100% locally.
items.value: Fewer tokens and tool calls; boosts coding-agent efficiency

items.title: "The harness is the company": SaaS becomes a shell around a model
items.desc: A hot HN post (86 points, 65 comments) argues every SaaS business will become a harness around a model, sparking broad debate on software business model sustainability.
items.value: Moats shift from features to harness and workflow design

items.title: "Is anybody producing good code with coding agents?"
items.desc: An HN discussion on actual coding-agent output (alongside the "Four Horsemen of Agentic Coding" post at 105 points, 80 comments) continues, with developers still skeptical of agent-generated code quality.
items.value: Agentic coding still needs methodology and tooling to land
